User: It was spontaneous, not planned. What would have changed? That decision is time and access. If I definitely had more time or if I had been closer to home with food already prepared, I wouldn't have gotten fast food. Even a short pause in the day to reset would have shifted the choice. Fast food for me fills the gap when the day moves faster than I really expected.
Agent: That's very insightful. Did you switch from your usual chain or usual item today? If so, what exactly caused that switch?
